name: estack
description: estack: rigorous agent workflows built on pstack by Lauren Tan. A playbook-routing orchestrator, three-seat review panels, parallel arenas and swarms, independent verification, and 24 engineering principles, with each seat's model and effort set per call. Includes an enterprise layer: 18 specialist seats, 12 enterprise playbooks, PRD-to-business-rule cards, and opt-in approval-gate hooks on push, deploy, and migration commands.
